messages.content:

Η δόνηση σταμάτησε έπειτα από περίπου επτά λεπτά.

Δεν υπήρχε ορατό νερό, καπνός, μυρωδιά καμένου, διακοπή ρεύματος ή ζημιά. Το επόμενο πρωί ο διαχειριστής έλεγξε τον κοινόχρηστο διάδρομο και την ταράτσα, αλλά δεν εντόπισε προφανή αιτία. Το συμβόλαιο ονομάζεται «Κατοικία Plus» και έχει αριθμό ΑΘ-482731. Σε προηγούμενο μήνυμά της, η ασφαλιστική ανέφερε παραπομπή σε εγκεκριμένο τεχνικό, χωρίς να εξηγεί αν πρέπει να την εξασφαλίσω εγώ πριν κλείσω επιθεώρηση ή αν η ίδια αναλαμβάνει τη διαδικασία.

Το email να έχει 170 έως 210 ελληνικές λέξεις, γραμμή θέματος και ακριβώς τρεις παραγράφους: περιστατικό, τρέχουσες παρατηρήσεις και ζητούμενες οδηγίες. Οι παράκτιοι υγρότοποι, όπως τα έλη και οι λιμνοθάλασσες, μπορούν να μειώσουν τις επιπτώσεις μιας πλημμύρας. Τα φυτά τους επιβραδύνουν την κίνηση του νερού, ενώ το έδαφος και οι ρηχές λεκάνες συγκρατούν προσωρινά μέρος του. messages.content: Θα μπορούσατε να μου δώσετε μια ιεραρχημένη διαδικασία ελέγχου και ένα σύντομο, επαγγελματικό μήνυμα για εναλλακτικό κανάλι; Εξέδωσα μέσω Invoice Ninja τιμολόγιο €680 με προθεσμία 5 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026· στις 8 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026 καταγράφηκε αυτόματη υπενθύμιση ως «Sent», όμως ο πελάτης δεν την έλαβε, και αφού επιβεβαίωσα τη διεύθυνση και την έστειλα ξανά χειροκίνητα, το ιστορικό έδειξε πάλι «Sent», χωρίς μήνυμα αποτυχίας, ενώ δεν βρέθηκε τίποτα ούτε στα εισερχόμενα ούτε στα ανεπιθύμητα. person: A 75-year-old former café owner in Karditsa who follows municipal decisions and types with one finger.

instance.deliverable: Στοχευμένα βήματα για να διαπιστωθεί αν λείπει κάποια ενέργεια στην πλατφόρμα ή αν απαιτείται παρέμβαση του δήμου πριν λήξει η παράταση.

person: A 77-year-old former dockworker in Liverpool, England, who lives alone, follows local planning decisions and borrows audiobooks from the library.

instance.task_summary: Troubleshoot an audiobook that will no longer download in BorrowBox after the user accidentally removed its local copy.

He accidentally tapped “Delete Download” at chapter 7 and now fears that he returned or damaged the library's copy.
The loan page still says “Borrowed until 28 September 2026,” but each new download attempt stops at 1%.

constraints.text: Present the mistake, concern, system state, attempted fixes, comparison test, storage observation, and desired outcome in one paragraph.

constraints.params: device and app, symptom, attempted fixes, diagnostic observations
constraints.text: Include the iPad, BorrowBox version, 1% download stall, restart and account refresh, successful download of another title, remaining loan status, and available storage.

instance.deliverable: A reassuring explanation of what “Delete Download” changed and a prioritized recovery procedure that protects the user's listening position.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that deleting a local download does not delete the library's master copy or necessarily return the loan, as confirmed by the active-loan label. Treat the title-specific 1% failure as distinct from Wi-Fi or general storage failure. Recommend preserving or noting chapter 7, checking the title under active loans, updating the app, retrying after clearing only that title's download, and contacting the library or BorrowBox support if the title remains corrupt; do not promise that the exact playback position will survive signing out.

story: He accidentally removed the audiobook while listening and has been worrying that he somehow damaged the library’s master copy. Because other downloads work and the loan remains active, he wants a careful procedure that will preserve his place rather than more trial and error.

messages.content: Could you please help me restore an audiobook in BorrowBox 3.13 on my ninth-generation iPad? I accidentally tapped “Delete Download” at chapter 7 of Cyprus: Folk Songs and Dances, and I am worried that I may have returned it or damaged the library’s copy; however, the loan page still says “Borrowed until 28 September 2026,” while every attempt to download it again stops at 1%. I have restarted the iPad, signed out of BorrowBox and back in to refresh the account, and confirmed that another audiobook downloads normally over the same Wi-Fi connection; the iPad also shows 18 GB of free storage. person: A 32-year-old supermarket cashier in Larissa who coordinates care for a father recovering from a stroke.

instance.task_summary: Explain simply the literal and symbolic meaning of the ending of Papadiamantis’s The Murderess before an evening book-club discussion.
givens: The user is discussing «Η Φόνισσα» by Alexandros Papadiamantis at a book-club meeting tonight at 20:00.
She understands that Frangoyannou is fleeing after killing several girls but is confused about whether the final drowning is an accident, divine punishment, or a deliberate act.

constraints.text: The request and response are in Greek.
Use plain language and clearly separate the literal events from their symbolic interpretation.
The user provides several personal and interpretive details in an unordered, conversational way.

instance.deliverable: A simple Greek explanation of what literally happens at the end, followed by the principal interpretation of the final phrase and a concise point the user can raise at the book club.
instance.answer_conditions: State that Frangoyannou drowns while trying to cross toward the hermitage, before the pursuing authorities arrest her. Explain that the closing position between divine and human justice is deliberately symbolic: she escapes a human trial but not moral or divine judgment. Do not present the drowning as clearly intentional, because the text does not establish suicide. Keep the explanation accessible and acknowledge that more than one literary emphasis is possible.

story: She has a book-club meeting after a tiring day spent arranging her father’s care, and she cannot settle the ambiguity of the ending in her mind. She wants a defensible interpretation, not a vague literary summary, because she has heard several competing explanations.

messages.content: Θα μπορούσατε να μου εξηγήσετε απλά το τέλος από «Η Φόνισσα»; Η συζήτηση της λέσχης βιβλίου είναι απόψε στις 20:00 και, επειδή αυτές τις μέρες κανονίζω τα φάρμακα και τις φυσικοθεραπείες του πατέρα μου μετά το εγκεφαλικό, διάβαζα κάπως αφηρημένα και δεν προλαβαίνω να ξαναδιαβάσω όλο το έργο. Καταλαβαίνω ότι η Φραγκογιαννού φεύγει αφού έχει σκοτώσει αρκετά κορίτσια, αλλά δεν μου είναι καθόλου σαφές αν ο τελικός πνιγμός είναι ατύχημα, θεϊκή τιμωρία ή συνειδητή πράξη της ίδιας. Έχω ακούσει διαφορετικές εκδοχές και δεν θέλω να δεχτώ μία ερμηνεία χωρίς αιτιολόγηση, οπότε σας παρακαλώ να ξεχωρίσετε καθαρά τι συμβαίνει κυριολεκτικά από το τι συμβολίζει. Επίσης, σε τι ακριβώς βασίζεται η κύρια ερμηνεία της φράσης ότι βρέθηκε ανάμεσα στη «θεία και την ανθρώπινη δικαιοσύνη»; Θα ήθελα αρκετό πλαίσιο για να το συζητήσω σωστά, καθώς και ένα σύντομο σημείο που μπορώ να θέσω στη λέσχη.

person: A 40-year-old grape-harvest contractor in Tirnavos who coordinates transport for workers from several language backgrounds.

instance.task_summary: Explain why six registrations alone do not prove that families are uninterested in a school fundraiser.

person: A 70-year-old former miner in Megalopolis who is navigating compensation paperwork and distrusts unsolicited calls.
situation: A research article is dense with unfamiliar terminology.

instance.task_summary: Explain HDD, SSD, and USB 3.2 simply and connect those concepts to choosing a drive for backups.

constraints.text: The request and response are in Greek.

instance.answer_conditions: Explain that HDD and SSD describe storage technology, while USB 3.2 describes the connection standard and does not by itself guarantee the drive’s real speed. Contrast HDD cost and capacity with SSD speed, silence, and resistance to knocks. Connect those facts to backups without pretending one choice is universally best, and note briefly that a backup should not be the only copy.

story: He needs an external drive for dependable backups but finds the product terminology opaque. He wants the basic distinctions explained before receiving practical buying guidance.

messages.content: Ξέρω μόνο ότι ο δίσκος κρατά αρχεία. Εξήγησέ μου απλά HDD, SSD και USB 3.2 και πώς επηρεάζουν τα αντίγραφα ασφαλείας.

person: A 58-year-old cleaner in Hamburg who attends a Greek folk-theatre group and has never owned a computer.
situation: An exam is approaching, but one concept still will not click.

instance.task_summary: Explain what a professional portfolio is, how it differs from a CV, and how to assemble a paper version for an exam.

First correct the CV misconception, then explain the portfolio’s purpose, and finally construct an ordered paper example.

The user gives a paragraph of context, prior belief, date, and available materials.

instance.answer_conditions: Explain that a CV summarizes experience, whereas a portfolio supplies selected evidence of skills and work; it is not a folder of duplicate CVs. Give an accessible paper order such as cover page, one CV, brief role description, programme, two captioned photographs, recommendation, and contact details. Clarify what each item demonstrates and avoid assuming computer access.

story: Her vocational exam is close, and the online examples in her study materials have made portfolios seem more mysterious than they are. She wants to use familiar theatre documents to understand the concept and describe it confidently without needing a computer.

messages.content: Προετοιμάζομαι για εξετάσεις επαγγελματικών ελληνικών στο Αμβούργο στις 24 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026, αλλά δεν έχω ποτέ αποκτήσει ή χρησιμοποιήσει υπολογιστή και με μπερδεύουν τα παραδείγματα διαδικτυακών portfolio. Νόμιζα ότι επαγγελματικό portfolio σημαίνει πως βάζω σε έναν φάκελο πολλά αντίγραφα του βιογραφικού μου. Από τη θεατρική ομάδα μου έχω δύο φωτογραφίες από παραστάσεις, ένα πρόγραμμα όπου αναφέρομαι ως βοηθός ενδυματολογίας και μια σύντομη σύσταση του σκηνοθέτη. Μπορείς πρώτα να διορθώσεις αυτή την εντύπωση, μετά να μου εξηγήσεις απλά τον σκοπό του portfolio και τη διαφορά του από το βιογραφικό και, τέλος, να μου δώσεις ένα παράδειγμα με τη σωστή σειρά για ένα χάρτινο portfolio που θα μπορούσα να περιγράψω στις εξετάσεις, χωρίς υπολογιστή ή ιστοσελίδες;

person: A 40-year-old warehouse forklift operator in Rotterdam, Netherlands, who learned English at work and coaches a girls' handball team.

person: A 83-year-old retired priest's housekeeper in a village near Sparta who manages a small inherited olive plot.

story: After heavy rain, an elderly housekeeper checks a damp patch and becomes confused by the reported average. She understands the addition but wants the division step explained simply.

person: A 81-year-old former seamstress in Campina Grande, Brazil, who lives with a granddaughter and dictates requests about recipes, medication schedules, and church-community events.

person: A 48-year-old cardiology nurse in Athens who works twelve-hour shifts and organizes a communal apartment garden.

instance.task_summary: A nurse asks why the notation 12–14 may contain three integers even though subtracting the endpoints gives two, in the context of a rejected address.
givens: An online application rejects the address «Λεωφόρος Αλεξάνδρας 12–14».
The user believes 14−12=2 means that the range contains two numbers.
The user has been told that the inclusive integer count is three and asks when subtraction measures count versus distance.

constraints.text: The request is written in standard Greek.
The request is no more than 30 words and includes only the rejected address, misconception, and mathematical question.
The answer must distinguish mathematical interval counting from the possible conventions of street-address notation.

instance.deliverable: A concise Greek explanation distinguishing endpoint distance, inclusive integer count, and address-range interpretation.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that 14−12 = 2 is the distance or number of unit gaps, while the consecutive integers 12, 13, 14 number 14−12+1 = 3. Also state that an address written 12–14 may conventionally denote only buildings 12 and 14 or a combined property, so mathematics alone cannot establish why the portal rejected it; the portal's accepted house-number convention would be needed.

person: A 16-year-old secondary-school student in Alexandroupoli who repairs old game controllers and shares a room with his younger brother.
situation: A strange sound at night causes worry, though nothing obvious is wrong.

instance.task_summary: A teenager asks why sounds repeating every 18 and 24 seconds coincide after 72 seconds rather than after their 42-second sum.
givens: One sound repeats every 18 seconds and another every 24 seconds.
The user expects the next coincidence after 42 seconds because 18+24=42.
The stated correct coincidence time is 72 seconds.

constraints.text: The request is written in standard Greek.
The entire request is one line of at most 12 words.
The explanation must connect each repetition sequence to their least common multiple.

instance.deliverable: A compact Greek explanation of why the next simultaneous occurrence is at 72 seconds.
instance.answer_conditions: Assume the sounds occur together at time zero. Show or compare multiples of 18 and 24, identify 72 as their least common multiple, and explain that adding the periods does not generally find a shared repetition time. Verify that 72/18 = 4 and 72/24 = 3, whereas 42 is divisible by neither.

story: He hears two repeating sounds at night and has calculated when they should next occur together. His addition-based prediction conflicts with the stated answer, so he wants the reason explained.

messages.content: Γιατί οι περίοδοι 18 και 24 συμπίπτουν στα 72, όχι 42;

person: A 25-year-old hotel receptionist in Lausanne, Switzerland, who works rotating shifts and is learning German for career advancement.
situation: A permit renewal requires documents scattered across several folders.

instance.task_summary: A Lausanne hotel receptionist asks in French why learning fractions from successive portions of a German vocabulary list cannot be added directly.
givens: The learner has a list of 48 German words.
She initially knows three quarters of the list.
She then learns two thirds of the words that remained unknown.
She believes adding 3/4 and 2/3 implies she knows more than the entire list.

constraints.text: The explanation must first identify the remaining words and then apply 2/3 to that remainder before finding the total known.
The implied user message is: «Sur 48 mots allemands, j’en connais 3/4, puis j’apprends 2/3 du reste. Pourquoi ne puis-je pas additionner 3/4 et 2/3 ?»

instance.deliverable: A concise French explanation of the changing reference group, with the correct calculation and total vocabulary learned.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that 3/4 of 48 is 36, leaving 12; 2/3 of 12 is 8; therefore 44 of 48 words are known. Explicitly resolve the misconception by noting that the two fractions have different wholes and cannot be added directly.

story: She is reviewing German vocabulary between hotel shifts and tracking her progress through a fixed list. Adding the two fractions gives an impossible result, so she wants to understand how the reference group changes.

messages.content: Sur 48 mots allemands, j’en connais 3/4, puis j’apprends 2/3 du reste. Pourquoi ne puis-je pas additionner 3/4 et 2/3 ? Explique-moi le calcul et le total.

person: A 65-year-old retired firefighter in Brisbane, Australia, who volunteers with a flood-recovery group and has recently bought his first tablet.
situation: A flight was changed, breaking every later connection.

instance.task_summary: Explain simply why a change to one flight does not automatically rebook later flights purchased on a separate ticket.
givens: In June 2025, Qantas moved the user's Brisbane–Sydney flight on 7 August 2025 from 08:10 to 15:40.
The user separately booked an Emirates Sydney–Dubai–Athens itinerary departing Sydney at 20:10 on the same date.
The bookings have different reference numbers: QF6K2P and EK9R4T.
The Qantas tablet app shows only the Brisbane–Sydney sector, which has made the user worry that the later flights were deleted.

constraints.text: Respond in plain English.
Explain the concept without airline jargon, or define any necessary term immediately.
Explain the general position as understood in June 2025, without claiming to know unpublished fare conditions.
Answer the single question of why the later itinerary was not changed automatically.

instance.deliverable: A simple explanation of separate bookings, including why only one flight appears in the Qantas app and what that does and does not imply.
instance.answer_conditions: The response must explain that different booking references normally mean the airlines' systems do not treat the flights as one protected itinerary. It must calculate that the revised scheduled gap is 4 hours 30 minutes, clarify that absence from the Qantas app does not mean the Emirates flights were deleted, and avoid guaranteeing that the connection is feasible without airport, baggage, check-in, and fare details.

story: He has just noticed that his carefully planned trip no longer connects and is struggling to understand what the tablet app is showing. Because this is his first tablet, he fears that the missing flights have actually been deleted rather than merely being absent from one airline’s app.

messages.content: I’m getting really worried about this. In June 2025, Qantas moved my Brisbane–Sydney flight on 7 August 2025 from 08:10 to 15:40, but I separately booked Emirates from Sydney to Dubai and then Athens, leaving Sydney at 20:10 that day. The booking references are QF6K2P and EK9R4T. My Qantas tablet app only shows Brisbane–Sydney. Why weren’t the later flights changed automatically, and does them not appearing there mean they’ve been deleted? Please explain in plain English without airline jargon, since I don’t know the unpublished fare conditions.

person: A 44-year-old humanitarian logistics officer from Crete working in Geneva who travels with minimal luggage.
situation: A first date is approaching after a long break from dating.

instance.task_summary: Explain in simple Greek, in three steps, how to arrange a first date safely after a long break from dating.
givens: The user asks only how to arrange a safe first date.

constraints.text: Respond in Greek.
Keep the explanation direct and easy to follow.
Organize the answer into exactly three practical steps.
The implied user message is one line of at most 12 words and contains no personal background.
Cover the meeting place, independent travel arrangements, and a check-in or exit plan as connected steps.

instance.deliverable: A three-step, simple Greek explanation.
instance.answer_conditions: The response must give exactly three concise steps: choose a public place, keep independent transport and minimal belongings under the user's control, and tell a trusted person the plan or arrange a check-in while preserving an easy way to leave.

story: She wants a compact checklist she can remember easily while arranging the date. Her professional habits make her value clear contingency planning, but she does not want to share personal background.

messages.content: Εξήγησέ μου σε τρία βήματα πώς οργανώνω ασφαλές πρώτο ραντεβού.

held_reasons: The message preserves both intervals and totals, stays within the 12-word bare limit, and naturally conveys frustration while asking for the required explanation.
person: An 82-year-old retired shopkeeper in Leicester, England, who speaks Gujarati at home and is compiling family recipes for great-grandchildren.
situation: The household calendar has become a maze of overlapping commitments.

instance.task_summary: A retired shopkeeper asks why two overlapping calendar intervals occupy 150 minutes rather than 180 minutes.
givens: One calendar commitment runs from 10:00 to 11:30.
A second commitment runs from 11:00 to 12:30.
Each interval lasts 90 minutes.
The learner currently adds both durations and overlooks the shared 30 minutes.

constraints.text: The implied user message is: “Why do 10:00–11:30 and 11:00–12:30 total 150 minutes, not 180?”
The explanation must recognize the overlap and subtract it from the sum of the two durations.

instance.deliverable: A simple English explanation of elapsed union time and double-counted overlap.
instance.answer_conditions: Show that 90 + 90 counts 11:00–11:30 twice, so subtracting the 30-minute overlap gives 150 minutes; alternatively explain that the combined occupied span is 10:00–12:30.

person: A 24-year-old junior archaeologist in Pella who flies kites with local children and manages field notes offline.
situation: A child is nervous about starting at a new school.

instance.task_summary: A junior archaeologist asks in Greek for a reassuring child-friendly explanation of why 18 available bicycles out of 24 means 75%, not 18%.
givens: The city-bike station near the child’s new school has 24 bicycle positions.
The rental screen shows 18 bicycles available.
The child thinks the availability is 18% because the screen shows 18 bicycles.
The archaeologist wants to use the example during a practice journey to make the child more comfortable with the new school route.

constraints.text: Use the single direct proportion 18 out of 24 to explain the percentage.
Keep the explanation warm, concrete, and easy to visualize without introducing unnecessary formulas.
The implied user message gives the school-route context, the station capacity, the displayed bicycle count, the child’s misconception, and the desired reassuring tone.

instance.deliverable: A detailed Greek explanation suitable for the child, including the correct fraction and percentage.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that the percentage compares the 18 available bicycles with all 24 positions: 18/24 = 3/4 = 75%. Directly correct the belief that the count 18 automatically means 18%, and use a simple visual grouping or equivalent child-friendly illustration.

story: She is planning a practice trip past the bicycle station so the child can become familiar with the route before starting school. She wants an explanation she can repeat confidently, but she is not willing to accept the percentage without seeing why it follows from the displayed numbers.

messages.content: Κατά τη δοκιμαστική διαδρομή προς το νέο σχολείο, θέλω να βοηθήσω ένα παιδί να νιώσει πιο άνετα χρησιμοποιώντας ως παράδειγμα τον κοντινό σταθμό ποδηλάτων. Ο σταθμός έχει 24 θέσεις και η οθόνη δείχνει 18 ποδήλατα διαθέσιμα, όμως το παιδί θεωρεί ότι αυτό σημαίνει διαθεσιμότητα 18%. Θα μπορούσατε να του εξηγήσετε με ζεστό, καθησυχαστικό και εύκολο να οπτικοποιηθεί τρόπο γιατί τα 18 από τα 24 αντιστοιχούν σε 75%; Παρακαλώ βασίστε την εξήγηση στην άμεση αναλογία, ώστε να είναι σαφές πώς ελέγχεται το αποτέλεσμα, χωρίς περιττούς τύπους.
